thread:
sophia_prod: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — wanted a live thread to collect clarifying signals on the deals we lost this quarter and concrete asks we should action for roadmap/docs. I'll paste my short notes then please chime in.

mia_cs: copying notes from CS sync earlier: Acme (lost to vendor X), DataForge (integration pain + pricing), LegalEdge (compliance gaps). Main asks we heard: 1) clear SSO/KMS cert matrix, 2) lower-latency SLA for chat use-case, 3) prebuilt connector to Snowflake, 4) on-prem deployment checklist.

jamie_sales: for Acme specifically — they said we were great on model quality but competitor had a simpler managed migration and an active partnership with their SI. Price wasn't the primary blocker.

raj_eng: interesting — for migration complexity, what was the sticking point? large historical KV caching? infra network layout?

mia_cs: @raj_eng team said their CI/CD templates didn't match customer infra; the SI provided a turnkey adapter and migration runbook. Also some perf spikes on high-concurrency evals during POC.

li_cto: quick engineering take: perf spikes look like known hotspot in KV cache eviction under small-GPU config. We have a perf patch queued (ENG-5417) but it needs gating for compatibility. Can push a hotfix if PMs think it's priority.

ben_devrel: we should create a short "migration playbook" with code samples and a skeleton adapter for the common SI patterns. 1–2 hour guide + a repo starter would help.

jamie_sales: +1. Sales would love a reproducible demo that shows a migration path — helps with procurement and legal.

noah_support: LegalEdge raised concerns about encryption at rest and bringing-your-own-KMS. Our current doc covers KMS but not the exact HSM details they asked for. We should make an "Compliance checklist" artifact.

ops_bot: Deploy status: ENG-5417 patch in review; QA scheduled 2288001000.

sophia_prod: Actionable asks I'm hearing: (A) Migration playbook + demo repo (owner: devrel) (B) Compliance checklist + KMS/HSM details (owner: support/docs) (C) Prioritize ENG-5417 perf hotfix or provide a temporary config recommendation for Dedicated customers (owner: eng/runtime). Anyone disagree or want to add priorities? :thinking_face:

raj_eng: agree. Also suggest an immediate public note in docs listing recommended Dedicated instance types + config knobs to mitigate KV eviction until hotfix lands. Quick win.

li_cto: we can do a short "Recommended configs" doc and an accompanying quick cli snippet:

```
redwood cluster update --pool dedicated --gpu-type a100 --kv-cache-size 12GB --batching max=200
```

ship that as a stopgap.

ben_devrel: I'll prototype the demo repo (starter app + Snowflake connector example) and aim for a beta by next Friday.

mia_cs: I'll collate exact quotes from the three losses and attach them to the ticket so docs can be customer-meaningful (not paraphrase).

jamie_sales: sales ask: can we also get a short SLB (sales lead brief) one-pager highlighting the migration timeline and common blockers? That helps procurement.

noah_support: I'll draft the Compliance checklist and include KMS/HSM FAQ. Might need legal review but can mock the content first.

sophia_prod: Great. I'll turn this thread into an action list and create a triage ticket grouping: Migration Playbook (DEVREL-xxx), Docs Compliance Checklist (DOCS-yyy), Perf Hotfix/Config guidance (ENG-zzz). Thanks everyone. If you can, drop one-sentence updates here as you make progress so we can report in next week's sync. :white_check_mark: 

li_cto: tagging timeline: hotfix review by 2288000500, demo repo prototype by 2288000860.

ben_devrel: prototype repo link (draft): https://git.internal/redwood/migration-starter — will update with PRs.

ops_bot: Note: ticket ENG-5417 linked to this thread.

sophia_prod: closing loop — great input. We'll brief sales and support with the one-pagers and post the short-term config guidance in the docs site. If anyone has other postmortem signals (pricing sensitivity, SI partnerships, legal checklist items) drop them here.

jamie_sales: FYI — a recurring theme: customers want a predictable, short migration window and a named contact who owns the migration. Might be a professional services ask.

mia_cs: noted. Adding PS engagement recommendation to the CS playbook.

sophia_prod: perfect, thanks all.
